en: Black-and-white postcard view of a European town street lined with early-20th‑century buildings. On the left is a corner shop with large display windows and the sign 'KONEUM'. Several bicycles are parked at a stand nearby. Across the street are multi‑story residential and commercial buildings with ornate facades. A few pedestrians and several early motor vehicles or buses are visible on the cobblestone street. Printed at the bottom is the caption 'Altdöbern / N.L. Bahnhofstraße'.
